text: こんな　なんにもない　しまに　あそびに　きて　やったんだ　ありがたく　おもって　ほしいぜ　どうしても　かえって　ほしけりゃ　かかって　こいよ！

structure.jp: こんな　なんにもない　しまに
structure.en: to an island with nothing on it like this

structure.jp: あそびに　きて　やったんだ
structure.en: we did you the favor of coming to hang out

structure.jp: ありがたく　おもって　ほしいぜ
structure.en: I want you to feel grateful

structure.jp: どうしても　かえって　ほしけりゃ
structure.en: if you want us to leave that badly

patterns.name: 〜てやる
patterns.explanation: やる after a て-form verb means doing something for someone, said from above in a rough or cocky way. きて やった = 'we were kind enough to come'.

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.explanation: ほしい after a て-form verb means 'I want you to do it' (or, of someone else's wish, 'want someone to do it'). ありがたく おもって ほしい = 'I want you to feel grateful'.

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.span: かえって　ほしけりゃ
patterns.explanation: The ば ending means 'if'. ほしい becomes ほしければ, and rough speech squeezes that to ほしけりゃ. かえって ほしけりゃ = 'if you want us to go home'.
